idea-plugin.name: Connection Pool Config Companion
idea-plugin.description:
Warning on a HikariCP connection-pool setting (spring.datasource.hikari.* or bare hikari.*) set outside its own documented safe range in a .properties/.yml/ .yaml config file: connectionTimeout below 250ms, maxLifetime below 30000ms, idleTimeout below 10000ms, or idleTimeout set greater than or equal to maxLifetime (HikariCP silently ignores idleTimeout in that case -- a real, documented gotcha, not an invented rule).

100% static text analysis -- a plain-text line scanner, not a real properties/YAML parser, so it works whether the real HikariCP jar is on the classpath or not. Matches both connectionTimeout (Java-property style) and connection-timeout (Spring Boot's kebab-case relaxed binding).

Stated honestly: v0.1 only checks the four thresholds documented in HikariCP's own README/wiki -- it doesn't validate maximumPoolSize or other settings that don't have a single documented safe number (those depend on real workload sizing).

Free. No license nags, no telemetry, no network calls.

localInspection.displayName: HikariCP setting outside documented safe range
